prices: £850 to £1,200 — the migrated page's stated price, written once in the 'Affordable, Ethical Pricing' tick ('Our Blue Staffy puppies are priced between £850 and £1,200') and recorded in data/facts/buy-staffy-puppies-for-sale-uk.json as the page's whole price set. The band is below the locked prices and predates them (Known Issue 11): data/price-matrix.json holds £1,500 and £1,700 and a £500 refundable deposit. This page states no figure at all — /blue-staffy-pup-sale-uk/ is the price page and the two prices are stated there once.

'priced fairly and transparently, following MoneySavingExpert principles of value' and 'without inflated markups' — affordability claims measured against nothing, and against a consumer site that has never priced a puppy.
names: Jane and Tom of Croydon, South London, and Pamela M of Stockport — two testimonials that appear nowhere in data/reviews.json, which holds three real reviews. One of the three, The Victoria Family of Manchester, is on this page.

Bristol, Hull, Enfield, Croydon, Ilford, Peterborough, Bolton Street, Ramsbottom and Norwich — the towns the migrated delivery block names. data/settings.json is Carlisle · Cumbria at town level (Known Issue 16), no file on disk prices a destination, and project 5 owns the location cluster. The Norwich photograph is still carried at its original path and alt text (working rule 11); the prose does not name the town.

Royal Canin and SmartTrace — a feed brand and a microchip brand named in two migrated sub-headings. No file on disk records which feed or which chip provider is used, and naming a brand we cannot evidence is an endorsement rather than a fact.
tests: hip and elbow dysplasia — the migrated page's third and fourth screens, attributed to the British Veterinary Association. data/settings.json names no tests and data/boards/blue-staffy-health-uk.json carries L-2-HGA and HC-HSF4 as the DNA clearances with the wider screening in its own section; a third and fourth clearance named only here would be a second answer to a question the health page already answers, and the page links /blue-staffy-health-uk/ instead.
creds: Kennel Club Assured Breeder, claimed five times ('a Kennel Club Assured Breeder', 'backed by the Kennel Club Assured Breeder Scheme', 'Kennel Club Assured standards', 'operates under Kennel Club Assured Breeder guidelines', and as an anchor reading 'Assured Breeder'). No file on disk records a scheme membership, and /blue-staffy-uk-breeders/ states Kennel Club registration narrowly for exactly this reason and holds LICENCE_CLAIM_PLACEHOLDER until Lisa Bright confirms the licence wording. This is also why the `why-kc-explained` asset is the one image on this record whose alt is not the migrated wording: the migrated alt asserted the same membership twice, and an alt is page copy.

DEFRA approval as a breeder credential ('KC Registered & DEFRA Approved', 'We are a DEFRA-approved carrier'). data/settings.json holds DEFRA only inside delivery_note, which describes the transport a puppy travels in; the page says DEFRA-approved transport and claims no approval of its own.

lifetime and lifelong support ('Lifelong Family Support', 'We offer lifetime support for every one of our puppies', 'How Does BlueStaffyUK Offer Lifetime Support Compared to Other UK Dog Breeders?'). A support commitment with no end date and no file behind it. The page states the email address and the hours from data/settings.json, which is the support that can be evidenced.
the health guarantee implied by 'no hidden surprises' and by the migrated contract sentence. data/settings.json holds guarantee_days null, so there is no term, no length and no cover to state.

'BVA & RSPCA-aligned health standards' and 'our comprehensive puppy health protocol follows RSPCA recommendations' — an alignment with two organisations that have not assessed us. The page links the RSPCA's own puppy advice as independent reading and claims no endorsement.
text: 'Our Blue Staffy puppies are priced between £850 and £1,200, covering the true costs of health screening, nutrition, veterinary care, and early socialisation — without inflated markups.' — the health screening, the veterinary care and the early socialisation are restated in `health-testing` and `home-raised`; the band is not, for the reason in dropped.prices.

'Every Blue Staffy puppy we raise is backed by the Kennel Club Assured Breeder Scheme and DEFRA approval.' — Kennel Club registration is restated in `kennel-club`; the scheme membership and the DEFRA approval are not, for the reasons in dropped.creds.

'We combine the credibility of a Kennel Club Assured Breeder with the warmth of a family-first approach, ensuring your Blue Staffy puppy is raised ethically, responsibly, and with love.' — the family home is restated in `home-raised`; the scheme membership is not.

'According to the British Veterinary Association (BVA), Staffordshire Bull Terriers can be prone to hip and elbow dysplasia, and responsible breeders like BlueStaffyUK take proactive measures to protect puppy health.' — the conditions the breed is watched for are data/boards/blue-staffy-health-uk.json's own section, and this page links it rather than answering the same question twice.

'At BlueStaffyUK, our comprehensive puppy health protocol follows RSPCA recommendations, ensuring every Blue Staffy is protected against common health issues before joining their new family.' — the veterinary check, the microchip and the first vaccinations are restated in `kennel-club` and `after-care`; the claim to follow one organisation's protocol is not, for the reason in dropped.creds.

'🥩 Nutrition: Royal Canin Puppy Diet' and the paragraph under it — a named feed brand no file on disk records. `after-care` says the puppy comes home on the routine they already know and names no brand.

'Every puppy at BlueStaffyUK.uk comes with SmartTrace microchipping and a full set of puppy shots, following Kennel Club UK and DEFRA standards for Staffy health.' — the microchip and the first vaccinations are restated in `kennel-club`; the chip brand and the two standards bodies are not.

'We offer lifetime support for every one of our puppies and are always available to answer your questions, whether they are about training, health, or behavior.' — answering questions is restated in `after-care` against the hours in data/settings.json; the word lifetime is not, and neither is 'always available'.

'Effective puppy crate training is one of the best dog socialisation tips for establishing routine and security, which is why BlueStaffyUK incorporates it early to manage and prevent common Staffy separation anxiety for a smooth transition home.' — a training method and a behavioural outcome no file on disk records. `home-raised` says what a puppy has met in the house and links the Blue Cross's own socialisation advice.

'Our transport and handover strictly comply with DEFRA UK guidelines, guaranteeing that the Staffy puppy is moved safely and legally.' and 'the entire process at BlueStaffyUK strictly adheres to DEFRA Pet Transport Regulations' — DEFRA-approved transport is data/settings.json's delivery_note and is stated on /blue-staffy-pup-sale-uk/, which owns delivery; a guarantee of compliance is not a fact this repo holds.

'Families trust BlueStaffyUK.uk because we combine local delivery convenience with KC-registered, health-tested Staffy puppies using trusted DEFRA-approved Pet Bus or vehicles.' — the KC registration and the health testing are restated; the named carrier and the towns are not, for the reason in dropped.names.

'An English Staffordshire Bull Terrier from the UK will be registered with The Kennel Club and will adhere to their specific breed standard, which is smaller and more compact than the American variety.' and the five breed-identity answers around it — data/boards/uk-staffordshire-bull-terrier-guide.json owns the breed standard, the American Bully comparison and the Dangerous Dogs Act, and this page links the guide.

'Contact a Trusted Breeder Now 🐾 Reserve Your Blue Staffy Puppy Fill in your details below and we'll be in touch within 24 hours ⏰ Delivery Note: Delivery begins 24–48 hours after payment confirmation.' — the migrated reservation block. ContactFormKit renders its own note; the reply window this site states is the 24-48 business hours of data/faq.json's sale-reserve row, and the delivery timing is a promise no file on disk holds.
links: https://www.champdogs.co.uk/breeds/staffordshire-bull-terrier/clubs — the migrated 'Staffordshire Bull Terrier Club' link. It is a directory of breed clubs, not a page that evidences anything this outline states, and docs/reference/external-link-library.md has no row for it.

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Staffordshire_Bull_Terrier, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MoneySavingExpert.com and the two commons.wikimedia.org Staffordshire Bull Terrier categories — four encyclopaedia and image-library links carried as general reading. The breed material is /uk-staffordshire-bull-terrier-guide/'s and the MoneySavingExpert link supported the affordability claim in dropped.prices.
https://vcahospitals.com/know-your-pet/canine-health — a North American veterinary group's health hub, linked three times. /blue-staffy-health-uk/ cites UK sources for the same material.
https://www.royalcanin.com/us/dogs/puppy/puppy-feeding-and-nutrition — the feed brand's own feeding page, for the reason in dropped.names.

https://www.pets4homes.co.uk/breeders/dogs/staffordshire-bull-terrier — a classified site's breeder listings, linked three times. It is a competitor's directory, and this page's argument is that a directory badge is not evidence.
https://www.thepetbus.co.uk/ — a named pet courier, for the reason in dropped.names.

https://www.gov.uk/take-pet-abroad — linked twice as the DEFRA transport citation. It redirects to the government's international pet travel page, which does not describe a domestic delivery; /blue-staffy-pup-sale-uk/ owns delivery.

/uk-locations/staffy-breeding-dogs-glasgow/ (five times), /uk-locations/uk-staffordshire-bull-terrier-breeder/, /uk-locations/blue-staffy-puppies-london/, /uk-locations/blue-staffy-puppies-manchester-uk/, /uk-locations/blue-staffy-puppies-bristol-uk/ and /uk-locations/blue-staffy-puppies-uk/ — the migrated location-cluster links. Project 5 owns the location cluster and rewrites those pages; linking them from a rebuilt page before they are rewritten would point a reader at the material Known Issue 16 is about.
/blog/ (three times) — a route that is not in data/page-map.json. The blog hub is /blue-staffy-blog-guides/ and `after-care` links that.

#affordable-staffies, #contact-form (five times), #, and /#happy-owners-speak — the migrated page's in-page anchors, all pointing at fragments of the WordPress layout that no longer exists. The rebuilt page's own section ids are the jump targets and are owned by nav-anchors-resolve.

https://www.youtube.com/@BlueStaffyUK-v2d, https://www.instagram.com/bluestaffyukingdom and https://www.tiktok.com/@bluestaffyuk.uk — three social links in the body. The four socials in data/settings.json are rendered by the kit footer on every page, and TikTok is not one of them.
